verdict.rationale: Mailgun's docs explicitly describe Batch Sending via multiple 'to' recipients with Recipient Variables (mailgun-docs-14) and mailing lists with template variables (mailgun-docs-15), confirming a single-call personalized batch send capability. However, the evidence pack does not document a per-message status field in the API response for batch sends, nor any independent/hands-on confirmation of this behavior. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-message delivery status in the batch response, and community/hands-on corroboration of the batch API in practice.
